page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured within the KVM hypervisor environment. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. With a strict one-to-one mapping of physical cores to virtual CPUs, this instance guarantees dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage volumes for operating systems and data persistence. This architecture separates compute and storage, allowing for independent scaling of storage resources.

For network-heavy operations, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps. This high-throughput network interface, combined with the dedicated compute allocation, makes the instance suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, distributed caching, and middle-tier application servers. The resource density offers a balanced profile for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity without GPU acceleration.
